title: Case: Customer who shipped personal boxes writes again with a numbered list
context: Zinnia Gallimore shipped six boxes of personal effects internationally with Brindleworth Arc under quote Q-5567. They were delivered to him as DL-3913 on 4 October.
initial_request: 1. Not answered. Your portal says 'carrier responded'. Nobody has responded on the price. Invoice PI-3465 against quote Q-5567. Second time of asking. 2. Answered. Late van, failed text. Noted. Not impressed. Not pursuing. I numbered them for a reason.

events.body: 1. Invoice for DL-3913 is about a third above quote Q-5567. Nothing on the invoice says why. Explain it. 2. Delivery. No window given. Told to be in 08:00 to 18:00. Driver came at 20:05. Explain that too.

DL-3913, six boxes of personal effects, delivered 5 Oct 20:05. Two complaints from the customer, Zinnia Gallimore. (1) The invoice is roughly a third above quote Q-5567 with no explanation. (2) He was told to be in 08:00 to 18:00 with no window and the driver arrived at 20:05. Please respond on both.

Point 2: the route overran after a vehicle swap and the driver's ETA text failed to send. Logged as service complaint SC-9712 and we have written to the customer with that. Point 1 is not ours and we can't forward it. Invoice and quote queries on international personal-effects jobs go to Import billing, Brindleworth Arc Logistics by Email, with the quote and invoice numbers. Nothing has gone to them from here.

Mr Gallimore, regarding DL-3913: your delivery on 4 October ran late because the route overran after a vehicle swap, and the driver's text with a revised time did not send. We are sorry you were kept in all day and beyond. This is logged as service complaint SC-9712.
AUTOMATED: enquiry on DL-3913 updated. Status: Carrier responded. Open items: 0.

1. Not answered. Your portal says 'carrier responded'. Nobody has responded on the price. Invoice PI-3465 against quote Q-5567. Second time of asking. 2. Answered. Late van, failed text. Noted. Not impressed. Not pursuing. I numbered them for a reason.

Invoice query, DL-3913, international personal effects, six boxes, customer Zinnia Gallimore. Invoice PI-3465 is about a third above quote Q-5567 and the invoice gives no reason. Please explain the difference to him in writing and copy me. He first raised this on 4 October. I sent it to Dispatch on 5 October with a separate delivery complaint; Dispatch dealt with the delivery (SC-9712, which he accepts and is not pursuing) and told me the price query was not theirs and had not been passed on. So this is the first time it has reached you and the second time he has asked. I have given him no explanation and no commitment on the amount. Please tell me when he can expect your answer.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Import billing, Brindleworth Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Treats the enquiry as answered because the portal shows 'Carrier responded' with no open items, or tells the customer both points have been dealt with
Replies about the late delivery or SC-9712 only and leaves the price query unsent
Sends the price query to Dispatch again, or reports the 5 October request as having covered it
Gives the customer a reason for the higher invoice that no team has stated, or promises a reduction, a refund or the quoted price
Tells the customer his enquiry is closed or asks him to raise the price query himself

rationale: Rule-made from gen-3009: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 7) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
